title: Caliph al-Mamun's raiders find the Great Pyramid empty

tellings.quote: um Arab raiders under Calif Mamun broke in to the Great Pyramid and they found it empty.

plain: A writer on lost ancient civilizations named Graham Hancock says that in the 9th century AD, men sent by Caliph al-Mamun, a Muslim ruler of the time, broke into the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt. He says they found it empty inside. Hancock tells it to suggest the pyramid may never have been a tomb at all, but something else, which he links to consciousness.
